title: Realism edit of DRRs
summary: FLUX.2 klein-9B edits each DRR zero-shot toward a real X-ray's look; the masks stay as rendered.
does: FluXray's zero-shot edit (src/schwingnet/realism.py): FLUX.2 klein-9B, 4 steps at guidance 1.0, on renders of 1024 pixels, stored at 256. The renderer's exact 1024-pixel masks are kept beside every image, so the labels are the CT's, not the edit's. It runs as the realism flow's fixed plan, edit and then stats, under docs/research/flux-realism/PREREG.md; lora and eval are refused until a count of their own.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The edited DRRs, stored at 256 pixels a side, with the renderer's masks.

nondeterminism: A diffusion edit on a GPU is not bit-exact between cards; the flow records its settings, and the study's statistics are read over many images, not one.

generic.why: The edit takes 2-D DRR images (src/schwingnet/realism.py); a volume or a clip would need a model of its own.

today.note: the words realism edit and realism stats
